items.title: 我不使用人工智能给当地企业打电话，但我真的不同意用它来给 Xfinity 的糟糕客户支持打电话。当您的地址发生故障时，他们的电话系统将不允许您与人交谈...... / I don't use AI to call local businesses but I literally have no sympathy for using it to call Xfinity's shitty customer support. Their phone system won't let you talk to a human when your address has an active outage....
